03 / GOVERNANCE

The model proposes. Something else decides.

AI can reason freely. Touching real systems cannot be free. Identity, permissions and approval come from the execution layer — not from what the model says about itself.

Watch where it stops

Staging authority does not include production.

The same proposed action can be useful and still not be allowed. The policy decision happens before execution, not afterwards — so the flow stops and waits for a person.

Asking is not the same as being allowed.

What the boundary holds

Check the request. Keep the evidence.

Defining the controls for each workflow is part of the integration work, including how to stop something and who is allowed to approve an exception.

  1. 01

    Identity & authorization

    Trusted workload identity and explicit permissions. A model does not inherit another agent's authority by claiming to be it.

  2. 02

    Scope & approval

    Tool access and changes are bound to an approved target, operation and revision. If the intent changes, the approval has to be given again.

  3. 03

    State & audit

    Record the request, the policy decision, the approval and the outcome, so a reviewer can reconstruct what was allowed and what happened.

  4. 04

    Verify & reconcile

    Compare what actually happened against what was approved. Surface partial failures, unexpected changes and unresolved outcomes to someone who can act on them.

Review by risk and exception

Send people the cases that genuinely need a person.

AI handles the volume; people handle the judgment. What gets escalated is written down as a rule, so nobody is asked to trust a confidence score without seeing the evidence behind it.

  • 01

    Normal result

    Runs under the policy already approved.

  • 02

    High-value transaction

    Always goes to a person.

  • 03

    Missing evidence or conflicting data

    Stops and asks someone accountable.

  • 04

    Low confidence

    Escalates instead of guessing.

  • 05

    Against policy

    Blocked, then routed to review.

  • 06

    Wide blast radius

    Needs explicit approval first.
